versions.content: Naming convention for enumeration literals, status values and pre - processor directives All enumeration literals, status values and pre - proce ssor directives ( #define ) shall be labeled in the following way: <MIP>_<SN> Where here <MIP> is the Capitalized module implementation prefix of this BSW Module ( SWS_BSW_00102 ) and <SN> is the specific name. Only capital l etters shall be used. If <SN> consists of several words, they shall be separated by underscore. The pre - processor directives E_OK and E_NOT_OK are exceptions to this rule.
